sections.title: Bioengineering Laboratory Principles
sections.description: This course will cover a variety of bioengineering laboratory principles and techniques including data collection, analysis and reporting. Students will explore tools related to mechanics, materials and electronics with applications in the bioengineering field. Corequisite with BE 2200.
